program:
procedure WatchesFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new owner, then follow up once"
  policy WatchesPolicy
  sheet Watches "Watches" { owner: Text, email: Email, ready_on: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, serial_number: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Watches

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.owner}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Watches
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ready" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.owner default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

1. Sending a welcome email to the owner right away with the subject "Welcome".
2. Waiting for approval from me to send the initial email, which must be approved within 6 hours; if not, the automation should stop.
3. Updating the status to "contacted" once the initial email is sent.
4. Waiting 3 days before sending a follow-up email asking if there's anything they need help with.
5. Getting approval from me to send the follow-up email, which must also be approved within 6 hours; if not, the automation should stop.
6. Sending the follow-up email only if the watch status has not changed to "ready" or "cancelled".
7. Limiting the number of emails sent to 150 per day.
8. Ensuring the automation only sends emails between 09:00 and 21:00.

Thank you!

}

  allow read Visits(guest, phone, status)
  allow write Visits(status)
  allow contact Visits.phone
  deny reveal Visits.allergy_notes
  limit sends 100 per day
  send only between 09:00 and 21:00
}
sheets: sheet Visits "Visits" { guest: Text, phone: Phone, visit_at: DateTime, status: Text, cover: Money, allergy_notes: Text private }
program:
procedure CatcafeFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new guest, then follow up once"
  policy CatcafePolicy
  sheet Visits "Visits" { guest: Text, phone: Phone, visit_at: DateTime, status: Text, cover: Money, allergy_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Visits

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.guest default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the cafe! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Visits
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "visited" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.guest default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}
sop:
Could you set up an automation to handle follow-ups with guests after their visit? Here’s what I need:

1. When a new guest entry is added to the "Visits" sheet, send them a welcome message: "Hi [Guest Name], thanks for choosing the cafe! Reply with any questions." This message needs to be approved by me within 6 hours.
2. Wait 2 days before sending a follow-up message: "Hi [Guest Name], just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?" This also needs my approval within 6 hours.
3. Only contact guests between 9 AM and 9 PM.
4. Limit the number of messages sent to 100 per day.
5. Don’t share any notes related to allergies.
6. Update the guest status to "contacted" after sending the first message.
7. Stop the process if the guest has already visited or cancelled their visit.

Can you please handle this automation according to these conditions?

procedure BookstoreFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy BookstorePolicy
  sheet Holds "Holds" { customer: Text, email: Email, held_until: Date, status: Text, prepaid: Money, phone_note: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Holds

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the store! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Holds
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ready" or now_r.status == "expired" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure RetailFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy RetailPolicy
  sheet Orders "Orders" { customer: Text, email: Email, ordered_on: Date, status: Text, total: Money, card_note: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Orders

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Orders
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "shipped" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure SalonFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new client, then follow up once"
  policy SalonPolicy
  sheet Clients "Clients" { name: Text, phone: Phone, last_visit: Date, status: Text, tab: Money, color_formula: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Clients

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.name default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the salon! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Clients
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "lapsed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.name default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

- When a new client is added, send them a welcome SMS saying, "Hi [Client Name], thanks for choosing the salon! Reply with any questions."

- Please get my approval before sending both messages.
- The first message should be sent within 12 hours of receiving the request.
- The entire process must be completed between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM daily.
- No more than 150 messages can be sent in a day.

Thank you!

Best,
[Owner's Name]

1. When a new patient visit record is created, send an initial message saying, "Hi [Patient Name], thanks for choosing the clinic! Reply with any questions." Approval from you is needed within 2 hours; if not, the automation should stop.

2. After 2 days, send a follow-up message asking, "Hi [Patient Name], just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?" Again, approval from you is needed within 2 hours; if not, the automation should stop.

3. The system should only send up to 200 messages per day and should only send messages between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM.

4. Only the status updates and the initial and follow-up messages should be sent. No personal health information (diagnoses) should be disclosed.

5. Ensure the system updates the status to "contacted" after sending the first message and to "follow-up sent" after sending the

policy:
policy ClinicPolicy {
  allow read Visits(patient, phone, status)
  allow write Visits(status)
  allow contact Visits.phone
  deny reveal Visits.diagnosis
  limit sends 200 per day
  send only between 08:00 and 20:00
}
sheets: sheet Visits "Visits" { patient: Text, phone: Phone, starts: DateTime, status: Text, copay: Money, diagnosis: Text private }
program:
procedure ClinicFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new patient, then follow up once"
  policy ClinicPolicy
  sheet Visits "Visits" { patient: Text, phone: Phone, starts: DateTime, status: Text, copay: Money, diagnosis: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Visits

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.patient default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the clinic! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Visits
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.patient default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure AquariumFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy AquariumPolicy
  sheet TankOrders "TankOrders" { customer: Text, phone: Phone, install_on: Date, status: Text, price: Money, home_access: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in TankOrders

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.customer}, thanks for choosing the store! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch TankOrders
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"

    stop "already handled"

  send ok2
}

  allow read Repairs(client, phone, promised_on, status)

program:
procedure FurnitureWinBack {
  about "Nudge clients whose repair was long ago"
  policy FurniturePolicy
  sheet Repairs "Repairs" { client: Text, phone: Phone, promised_on: Date, status: Text, estimate: Money, address: Text private }
  trigger every thursday at 17:30

  let all = fetch Repairs
  let old = filter all where days_between(promised_on, today()) >= 30 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by promised_on first 15
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 15 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.client default 'there'}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the workshop."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}
sop: Can you please set up an automation to nudge clients whose repairs were promised over 30 days ago? The automation should run every Thursday at 5:30 PM. It should fetch all repair records, then select those where the repair was promised more than 30 days ago and the status isn't cancelled. From those, it should pick the oldest 15. Then, for each client, draft an SMS saying, "Hi [Client Name], it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the workshop." Only send these messages if approved by me within 12 hours; otherwise, stop the process. Also, make sure to send no more than 50 messages per day and only between 8 AM and 8 PM. No one except me should be able to see the clients' addresses. Thank you!

  sheet Treatments "Treatments" { customer: Text, phone: Phone, treat_on: Date, status: Text, price: Money, pet_notes: Text private }

}

program:
procedure ComicsFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new reader, then follow up once"
  policy ComicsPolicy
  sheet PullList "PullList" { reader: Text, email: Email, arrives_on: Date, status: Text, owed: Money, home_address: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in PullList

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.reader}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch PullList
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "held" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.reader}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure FilmlabWinBack {
  about "Nudge photographers whose film drop-off was long ago"
  policy FilmlabPolicy
  sheet Rolls "Rolls" { photographer: Text, email: Email, dropped_on: Date, status: Text, cost: Money, card_hint: Text private }
  trigger every friday at 10:00

  let all = fetch Rolls
  let old = filter all where days_between(dropped_on, today()) >= 42 and status != "lost"
  let oldest = sort old by dropped_on first 20
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 20 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.photographer default 'there'}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the lab."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

  about "Remind each family about their tuition due date"
  policy DaycarePolicy
  sheet Families "Families" { parent: Text, email: Email, due_date: Date, status: Text, balance: Money, health_notes: Text private }
  trigger every day at 16:00

  let due = filter all where due_date == today() + 3 days and status == "enrolled"

}

program:
procedure PrintshopFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy PrintshopPolicy
  sheet Jobs "Jobs" { customer: Text, email: Email, due: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, file_link: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Jobs

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Jobs
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "printed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}
sop:
Please set up an automation that follows the steps below:

1. Send a welcome email to a new customer right away.
2. Wait 2 days after sending the first email.
3. If the status changes to "printed" or "cancelled", stop the process.
4. Otherwise, send a follow-up email checking in on the customer.
5. Only allow these emails to be sent between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM.
6. Limit the daily sends to 200 emails.
7. Ensure the owner must approve both emails within 6 hours or the process stops.
8. Only the owner should review and approve the emails.

Thank you!

procedure FilmlabFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new photographer, then follow up once"
  policy FilmlabPolicy
  sheet Rolls "Rolls" { photographer: Text, email: Email, dropped_on: Date, status: Text, cost: Money, card_hint: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Rolls

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.photographer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the lab! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Rolls
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "developed" or now_r.status == "lost" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.photographer}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

  allow read SignOrders(client, email, due_on, status, proof_notes)
  allow contact SignOrders.email
  deny reveal SignOrders.proof_notes
  limit sends 100 per day
  send only between 08:00 and 20:00
  approval batch valid 2 hours max 100 preview 5
}
sheets: sheet SignOrders "SignOrders" { client: Text, email: Email, due_on: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, proof_notes: Text private }
program:
procedure SignsSignOrderReminders {
  about "Remind each client about their sign order"
  policy SignsPolicy
  sheet SignOrders "SignOrders" { client: Text, email: Email, due_on: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, proof_notes: Text private }
  trigger every tuesday at 08:00

  let all = fetch SignOrders
  let due = filter all where due_on == today() + 1 day and status == "ordered"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 100 email to r.email subject "Your sign order tomorrow": "Hi {r.client}, a reminder from the shop: your sign order is tomorrow."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

Please ensure the batch of emails is approved by me within 2 hours or the process stops. Thank you!

Thank you!

procedure AutorepairWinBack {
  about "Nudge customers whose pickup time was long ago"
  policy AutorepairPolicy
  sheet Jobs "Jobs" { owner_name: Text, phone: Phone, promised: DateTime, status: Text, estimate: Money, vin: Text private }
  trigger every day at 09:00

  let all = fetch Jobs
  let old = filter all where days_between(promised, today()) >= 60 and status != "cancelled"

  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 10 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.owner_name default 'there'}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the shop."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"

}

procedure FurnitureFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new client, then follow up once"
  policy FurniturePolicy
  sheet Repairs "Repairs" { client: Text, phone: Phone, promised_on: Date, status: Text, estimate: Money, address: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Repairs

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.client default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the workshop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Repairs
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ready" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.client default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure PoolFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new swimmer, then follow up once"
  policy PoolPolicy
  sheet SwimPasses "SwimPasses" { swimmer: Text, email: Email, expires_on: Date, status: Text, fee: Money, health_flags: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in SwimPasses

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.swimmer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the pool! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch SwimPasses
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "expired" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.swimmer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

}

procedure PetgroomerFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new pet owner, then follow up once"
  policy PetgroomerPolicy
  sheet Grooms "Grooms" { owner: Text, phone: Phone, appointment: DateTime, status: Text, price: Money, behavior_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Grooms

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.owner}, thanks for choosing the salon! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Grooms
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.owner default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

policy DaycarePolicy {
  allow read Families(parent, email, due_date, status)
  allow contact Families.email
  deny reveal Families.health_notes
  limit sends 150 per day
  send only between 08:00 and 18:00
  approval batch valid 30 minutes max 15 preview 5
}
sheets: sheet Families "Families" { parent: Text, email: Email, due_date: Date, status: Text, balance: Money, health_notes: Text private }
program:
procedure DaycareWinBack {
  about "Nudge familys whose tuition due date was long ago"
  policy DaycarePolicy
  sheet Families "Families" { parent: Text, email: Email, due_date: Date, status: Text, balance: Money, health_notes: Text private }
  trigger every day at 11:00

  let all = fetch Families
  let old = filter all where days_between(due_date, today()) >= 90 and status != "paused"
  let oldest = sort old by due_date first 15
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 15 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.parent}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the daycare."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

All other times, the process should stop if approval is not granted. No personal health notes should be included in any emails. Please make sure the system does not exceed 150 sends per day.

}

  about "Remind each patient about their cleaning"
  policy DentalPolicy
  sheet Patients "Patients" { name: Text, mobile: Phone, next_visit: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, medical_history: Text private }

}

program:
procedure BakeryFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy BakeryPolicy
  sheet CakeOrders "CakeOrders" { customer: Text, email: Email, pickup: Date, status: Text, price: Money, address: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in CakeOrders

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer}, thanks for choosing the bakery! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch CakeOrders
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "confirmed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

  policy MakerspacePolicy
  sheet Makers "Makers" { maker: Text, email: Email, renews_on: Date, status: Text, dues: Money, door_pin: Text private }
  trigger every tuesday at 10:00

  let all = fetch Makers
  let old = filter all where days_between(renews_on, today()) >= 30 and status != "cancelled"

  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 10 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.maker default 'there'}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the space."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

  about "Contact a new bowler, then follow up once"

  sheet Leagues "Leagues" { bowler: Text, phone: Phone, next_game: DateTime, status: Text, dues: Money, shoe_size_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Leagues

  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1

  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Leagues
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"

  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.bowler default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

  about "Contact a new pet owner, then follow up once"
  policy PetgroomerPolicy
  sheet Grooms "Grooms" { owner: Text, phone: Phone, appointment: DateTime, status: Text, price: Money, behavior_notes: Text private }

  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Grooms
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {

  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.owner}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure IcerinkFollowUpAfterWait {

  policy IcerinkPolicy
  sheet Skaters "Skaters" { skater: Text, email: Email, session_at: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, medical_info: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Skaters

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.skater default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the rink! Reply with any questions."

  send ok1

  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Skaters

}

program:
procedure IcerinkFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new skater, then follow up once"
  policy IcerinkPolicy
  sheet Skaters "Skaters" { skater: Text, email: Email, session_at: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, medical_info: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Skaters

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.skater default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the rink! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Skaters
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "skated" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.skater}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure LandscapingWinBack {
  about "Nudge customers whose quote was long ago"
  policy LandscapingPolicy
  sheet Quotes "Quotes" { customer: Text, email: Email, sent_on: Date, status: Text, amount: Money, gate_code: Text private }
  trigger every day at 17:30

  let all = fetch Quotes
  let old = filter all where days_between(sent_on, today()) >= 90 and status != "declined"
  let oldest = sort old by sent_on first 20
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 20 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.customer}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the company."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}
sop: Could you please set up an automation to nudge customers whose quotes were sent over 90 days ago and haven't been declined? The automation should run every day at 5:30 PM. procedure RestaurantFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new guest, then follow up once"
  policy RestaurantPolicy
  sheet Bookings "Bookings" { guest: Text, phone: Phone, at: DateTime, status: Text, deposit: Money, allergies: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Bookings

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.guest}, thanks for choosing the restaurant! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Bookings
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "seated" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.guest}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure GymWinBack {

  policy GymPolicy

procedure BookstoreWinBack {

  policy BookstorePolicy
  sheet Holds "Holds" { customer: Text, email: Email, held_until: Date, status: Text, prepaid: Money, phone_note: Text private }

  allow write Jobs(status)
  allow contact Jobs.email
  deny reveal Jobs.file_link
  limit sends 100 per day
  send only between 07:30 and 19:00
}
sheets: sheet Jobs "Jobs" { customer: Text, email: Email, due: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, file_link: Text private }
program:
procedure PrintshopFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy PrintshopPolicy
  sheet Jobs "Jobs" { customer: Text, email: Email, due: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, file_link: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Jobs

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Jobs
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "printed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

  allow read Grooms(owner, phone, appointment, status)

  deny reveal Grooms.behavior_notes

  send only between 09:00 and 21:00
  approval batch valid 30 minutes max 10 preview 5
}

procedure PetgroomerWinBack {
  about "Nudge pet owners whose grooming was long ago"
  policy PetgroomerPolicy
  sheet Grooms "Grooms" { owner: Text, phone: Phone, appointment: DateTime, status: Text, price: Money, behavior_notes: Text private }
  trigger every monday at 08:30

  let all = fetch Grooms
  let old = filter all where days_between(appointment, today()) >= 30 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by appointment first 10
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 10 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.owner default 'there'}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the salon."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure JewelryFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy JewelryPolicy
  sheet Tickets "Tickets" { customer: Text, phone: Phone, ready_on: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, insurance_value: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Tickets

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Tickets
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ready" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.customer}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"

  send ok2
}

procedure LandscapingFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy LandscapingPolicy
  sheet Quotes "Quotes" { customer: Text, email: Email, sent_on: Date, status: Text, amount: Money, gate_code: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Quotes

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer}, thanks for choosing the company! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Quotes
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "sent" or now_r.status == "declined" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure CostumeFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new renter, then follow up once"
  policy CostumePolicy
  sheet Rentals "Rentals" { renter: Text, phone: Phone, due_back: Date, status: Text, deposit: Money, id_number: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Rentals

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.renter default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Rentals
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "returned" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.renter default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure BookstoreWinBack {
  about "Nudge customers whose hold was long ago"
  policy BookstorePolicy
  sheet Holds "Holds" { customer: Text, email: Email, held_until: Date, status: Text, prepaid: Money, phone_note: Text private }
  trigger every day at 09:00

  let all = fetch Holds
  let old = filter all where days_between(held_until, today()) >= 60 and status != "expired"

  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 20 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.customer}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the store."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure FurnitureWinBack {
  about "Nudge clients whose repair was long ago"
  policy FurniturePolicy
  sheet Repairs "Repairs" { client: Text, phone: Phone, promised_on: Date, status: Text, estimate: Money, address: Text private }
  trigger every tuesday at 08:00

procedure AutorepairFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy AutorepairPolicy
  sheet Jobs "Jobs" { owner_name: Text, phone: Phone, promised: DateTime, status: Text, estimate: Money, vin: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Jobs

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.owner_name default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Jobs
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ready" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.owner_name}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
  notify owner "Please update the office manager yourself."
}

program:
procedure GymFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new member, then follow up once"
  policy GymPolicy
  sheet Members "Members" { name: Text, email: Email, renews_on: Date, status: Text, dues: Money, health_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Members

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.name default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the gym! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Members
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "expired" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.name default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2

procedure BakeryWinBack {
  about "Nudge customers whose pickup date was long ago"
  policy BakeryPolicy
  sheet CakeOrders "CakeOrders" { customer: Text, email: Email, pickup: Date, status: Text, price: Money, address: Text private }
  trigger every wednesday at 10:00

  let all = fetch CakeOrders
  let old = filter all where days_between(pickup, today()) >= 30 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by pickup first 20
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 20 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.customer}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the bakery."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

  allow read Holds(customer, email, status)

  deny reveal Holds.phone_note
  limit sends 200 per day
  send only between 09:00 and 21:00

sheets: sheet Holds "Holds" { customer: Text, email: Email, held_until: Date, status: Text, prepaid: Money, phone_note: Text private }
program:
procedure BookstoreFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy BookstorePolicy
  sheet Holds "Holds" { customer: Text, email: Email, held_until: Date, status: Text, prepaid: Money, phone_note: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Holds

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the store! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Holds
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ready" or now_r.status == "expired" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}
sop:
Please review and approve the following automation:

1. When a new customer is added to the "Holds" sheet, send a welcome email to the customer with the subject "Hi [Customer Name], thanks for choosing the store! Reply with any questions." The email should be approved within 2 hours.
2. Wait 3 days after sending the first email.
3. Check the "Holds" sheet again after the 3-day wait. If the customer has not been contacted yet, draft a follow-up email with the subject "Checking in": "Hi [Customer Name], just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?" This email also needs to be approved within 2 hours.
4. The automation should not send more than 200 emails per day and should only run between 9 AM and 9 PM.

Thank you!

procedure BikeshopFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy BikeshopPolicy
  sheet Repairs "Repairs" { customer: Text, phone: Phone, ready_on: Date, status: Text, estimate: Money, lock_code: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Repairs

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Repairs
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ready" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

  allow read Families(parent, email, due_date, status)
  allow contact Families.email
  deny reveal Families.health_notes
  limit sends 100 per day
  send only between 07:30 and 19:00
  approval batch valid 1 hour max 15 preview 5
}
sheets: sheet Families "Families" { parent: Text, email: Email, due_date: Date, status: Text, balance: Money, health_notes: Text private }
program:
procedure DaycareWinBack {
  about "Nudge familys whose tuition due date was long ago"
  policy DaycarePolicy
  sheet Families "Families" { parent: Text, email: Email, due_date: Date, status: Text, balance: Money, health_notes: Text private }
  trigger every day at 09:00

  let all = fetch Families
  let old = filter all where days_between(due_date, today()) >= 90 and status != "paused"
  let oldest = sort old by due_date first 15
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 15 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.parent}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the daycare."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 1 day else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}
sop:
Hey assistant,

Could you please set up an automation to nudge families whose tuition due date was over 90 days ago? Here are the details:

- The automation should run daily at 9 AM.
- It should only send messages between 7:30 AM and 7 PM.
- Only 100 messages can be sent each day.
- Fetch all families from the "Families" sheet.
- Filter for families whose due date is over 90 days past and who are not marked as "paused".
- Sort these families by due date and select the top 15.
- Draft an email for each of these 15 families with the subject "We miss you" and the body: "Hi {r.parent}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the daycare."
- Send a batch approval request for these emails to me within one hour and let me know if it isn't approved within a day.
- Ensure the approval batch can preview up to 5 emails.

Thanks!

Best,
[Owner’s Name]

procedure NotaryWinBack {
  about "Nudge signers whose signing was long ago"
  policy NotaryPolicy
  sheet Signings "Signings" { signer: Text, email: Email, signing_at: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, id_number: Text private }
  trigger every day at 11:00

  let old = filter all where days_between(signing_at, today()) >= 60 and status != "cancelled"

}

  sheet Repairs "Repairs" { customer: Text, phone: Phone, ready_on: Date, status: Text, estimate: Money, lock_code: Text private }

program:
procedure ClinicFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new patient, then follow up once"
  policy ClinicPolicy
  sheet Visits "Visits" { patient: Text, phone: Phone, starts: DateTime, status: Text, copay: Money, diagnosis: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Visits

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.patient}, thanks for choosing the clinic! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Visits
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.patient default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure NotaryWinBack {
  about "Nudge signers whose signing was long ago"
  policy NotaryPolicy
  sheet Signings "Signings" { signer: Text, email: Email, signing_at: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, id_number: Text private }
  trigger every monday at 09:00

  let all = fetch Signings
  let old = filter all where days_between(signing_at, today()) >= 90 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by signing_at first 15
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 15 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.signer default 'there'}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the office."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure MusicFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new student, then follow up once"
  policy MusicPolicy
  sheet Lessons "Lessons" { student: Text, parent_phone: Phone, lesson_at: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, progress_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Lessons

  let first = draft sms to r.parent_phone: "Hi {r.student default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the school! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Lessons
  let now_r = find all where parent_phone == r.parent_phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.parent_phone: "Hi {now_r.student}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure CostumeWinBack {
  about "Nudge renters whose return date was long ago"
  policy CostumePolicy
  sheet Rentals "Rentals" { renter: Text, phone: Phone, due_back: Date, status: Text, deposit: Money, id_number: Text private }
  trigger every day at 16:00

  let all = fetch Rentals
  let old = filter all where days_between(due_back, today()) >= 30 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by due_back first 20
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 20 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.renter}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the shop."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}
